sources.note: Main website for Benchmark Solutions (formerly Benchmark Systems), a division of Harris. Overview of product suite: EHR, PM, RCM, ProTech. Describes 40+ year history, cloud-based modular architecture, and target market of independent/small practices.
EHR product page. Details on clinical documentation, e-prescribing, patient portal, automated coding recommendations, customizable templates for 40+ specialties, MIPS support, speech recognition.

Practice Management product page. Scheduling with multi-resource filtering, patient self-scheduling, appointment reminders, billing/claims management, integrated clearinghouse, Benchmark Pay, mobile provider portal, reporting dashboards.

RCM page. Patient registration/eligibility, charge entry, ICD/CPT coding, claim submission (97% first-pass), payment posting, denial management, patient statements, collections coordination. Reports 108% net collections, <33 day A/R.

Lists 27 supported specialties including family practice, internal medicine, pediatrics, cardiology, dermatology, OB/GYN, gastroenterology, orthopedics, urology, neurology, oncology, FQHCs, urgent care, surgery centers, and more.
About page. Headquartered in Forest, VA. Mission to help independent/small healthcare organizations. Division of Harris. Limited detail on company size or specific customer counts.

July 2023 acquisition announcement. Benchmark Systems acquired by Harris Healthcare (part of Constellation Software). Rebranded to Benchmark Solutions. All core offerings, client contracts, and support teams maintained. References 'thousands of practices across North America'.
ONC mandatory disclosure document (PDF). Could not parse content — binary PDF not readable by web fetch tool.

Third-party EMR listing. Mentions patient records, social histories, labs, specialty-specific templates, scheduling, billing/RCM, patient portal. Pricing from $147/month. 4/5 rating from 5 reviews. Cloud-based, Windows/Mac compatible.

Software Advice listing (could not access due to 403). Search results indicated 173 reviews, 4.74/5 rating. Users praised user-friendliness, efficiency, and customer service. Some noted limited space in follow-up sections and inconsistent support.

FindEMR listing. Describes as cloud-based RCM solution with claim scrubbing, payment posting, denial management, patient statements, automated coding recommendations, Benchmark Pay portal, comprehensive reporting.
Referenced in search results about Harris acquisition. Benchmark Solutions Co, LLC created June 2023 from EHR/PM/RCM assets of Benchmark Systems, Inc., then acquired by Harris.
